title: Modi at BRICS Business Forum: 'India is building bridges' amid global trade barriers
detail: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the BRICS Business Forum, declaring 'trade barriers are rising globally, India is building bridges,' positioning India as a neutral economic connector amid escalating tariff wars. The statement underscores India's strategic push to leverage its non-aligned stance to attract investment and deepen trade ties across competing blocs.

media.caption: PM Modi addresses BRICS Business Forum on India's role as global trade connector
